calling_guidance.summary: Use these MCP tools to query and control the local temperature-control desktop application.
preflight: Call temperature_get_status or temperature_refresh_snapshot before changing controller state.
Check snapshot.connection.primaryChannel and connection.*.connected before sending commands.
If channel is omitted, the system uses the current primary channel.
Use channel=serial for serial port control and channel=ethernet for ethernet control.
For manual PWM output, switch to MAN mode before setting PWM.
For target temperature control, switch to AUTO mode before setting temperature.
Use temperature_set_tran_pid for TRAN condition PID and temperature_set_fine_pid for FINE condition PID.
common_errors: Argument type or range is invalid.

tools.name: temperature_get_status
tools.description: Get the latest cached system snapshot, including connection, current mode, current condition, temperatures, PWM and PID configuration.
tools.when_to_use: Use this first when the user asks about current status, mode, condition, temperature or PID settings.

tools.name: temperature_refresh_snapshot
tools.description: Query the controller through the selected channel and refresh mode, condition, TRAN PID, FINE PID, FINE enable flag and deadband.
tools.when_to_use: Use this when the user wants the newest device-side state instead of the cached snapshot.

tools.name: temperature_set_mode
tools.description: Switch controller mode. AUTO means automatic temperature control; MAN means manual PWM control.
tools.when_to_use: Use before setting target temperature or manual PWM if current mode is not suitable.

tools.name: temperature_set_manual_pwm
tools.description: Set manual PWM output percentage. The controller should be in MAN mode before using this tool.
tools.when_to_use: Use when the user explicitly asks for manual heating/fan PWM output.

pwm.description: Manual PWM percentage. Positive values heat, negative values fan/cool if supported by firmware.

tools.name: temperature_set_target_temperature
tools.description: Set target temperature for AUTO mode.
tools.when_to_use: Use when the user asks to set or change the desired temperature.

tools.name: temperature_set_tran_pid
tools.description: Set TRAN condition PID parameters. TRAN is the variable-temperature / coarse control condition.
tools.when_to_use: Use when the user wants to tune the main variable-temperature PID parameters.

sepThreshold.description: Integral separation threshold in degrees Celsius.

tools.name: temperature_set_fine_pid
tools.description: Set FINE condition PID parameters. FINE is the near-target fine-tuning condition.
tools.when_to_use: Use when the user wants to tune near-target stability, small oscillation or fine adjustment behavior.

entryMin.description: Minimum absolute error to enter FINE condition.

entryMax.description: Maximum absolute error to enter FINE condition.

stableDelta.description: Allowed fluctuation in degrees Celsius during the stability window.

tools.name: temperature_set_deadband
tools.description: Set shared PID deadband in degrees Celsius.
tools.when_to_use: Use when the user wants to reduce near-target oscillation or adjust acceptable temperature error.

tools.name: temperature_set_fine_enable
tools.description: Enable or disable entry into FINE condition.
tools.when_to_use: Use when the user wants to allow or forbid automatic transition into FINE condition.

channel.description: Target channel. Omit this field to use the current primary channel.
